name: l2_scn_0928_the_queen_s_secret_v1
about: L2 scenario seed SCN-0928 (The Queen's Secret) overlaid on an Orion Station watch. A scandal involving a high figure (real or fabricated) becomes the lever for regime change. The truth matters less than who controls the narrative and paperwork. The seed is a pressure field and initial-condition template: roles, pressure axes, and knobs shape the run; expected end states are observation categories, never required endings. Root fixture only; not canon.
